capability.problem: Programmable collected Li/Na counterexchange from mixed feed with restored device state and complete regeneration cost.
capability.current_best: Established Donnan dialysis Li/Na counterexchange and selective electrodialysis under their measured feed/regeneration regimes; no universal best process asserted.
capability.limitation: Ratchet Li/Na/Cl species responses, side-resolved storage bounds and composite/reset additivity have not been acquired. Current and conductance alone do not identify exchange.
capability.proposed_mechanism: Acquire legal restored composite protocols and certify retained transport outside every capacity/error explanation, rather than inferring transport from a static mixture of current responses.

target.metric: lower confidence/capacity bound on collected counterexchange Qhat-eta-B/2
target.unit: moles per restored full cycle, then joules and recovered product per complete process
target.conditions: Same specimen/feed/affinity; Li+Na and chloride/other nuisance rows restored within tolerances, all switching/electrode/source/storage/reset included. Numerical target set before new data.
target.comparator: Equally informed Donnan dialysis/selective ED at matched feed, purity, recovery and regeneration boundary.

scientific_evidence.judgement: Conditional mathematics and acquired separate-regime primary records
scientific_evidence.limits: No measured restored Li/Na ratchet operation or efficiency.

feasibility_and_readiness.limits: Species control, storage calibration and coupled regime remain missing; no higher stage passed.

next_step_value.judgement: Acquisition gate before further waveform optimization
next_step_value.limits: Useful only if the predeclared retained exchange bound exceeds zero and matched full-process advantage survives.
